facts.text: The repository is the official release of simulation environments for the GR-1 Tabletop Tasks
The package is a RoboCasa fork that adds environments, assets and tooling for the GR-1 Tabletop tasks
The first task id in the README's list of 24 tabletop task names is gr1_unified/PnPCupToDrawerClose_GR1ArmsAndWaistFourierHands_Env
The simulation dependency is pinned to mujoco==3.2.6
GrootRoboCasaEnv extends RoboCasaEnv
RoboCasaEnv is a gymnasium.Env subclass
The wrapper creates its underlying environment with robosuite.make
The wrapper passes ignore_done=True to the robosuite environment
The per-part controller action Box is bounded by min -1 and max 1
A hybrid mobile base adds a Discrete(2) base_mode action
The GR-1 arms-and-waist key converter maps action.left_hand, action.right_hand, action.left_arm, action.right_arm and action.waist to the robosuite controllers
The key converter derives each action space key by prefixing the mapped name with 'action.' and bounds each Box by -1 and 1
The GR1 arms-and-waist initial joint vector is 17 values, with a seven-value right arm at indices 3:10 and a seven-value left arm at 10:17, leaving the first three values before the right arm
The Fourier hand action selection keeps the six values at indices 0, 1, 4, 6, 8 and 10
reset(seed, options) seeds numpy with the seed and resets the wrapped robosuite environment; the options argument is not used
step takes a dict of per-robot actions and calls the wrapped environment's step
The wrapper reports truncated=False on every step
The Groot observation image resolution is 256 x 256
The Groot image observation is a uint8 Box of shape 256 x 256 x 3
The Groot language annotation is a Text field of max_length 256
The gr1_unified id prefix is used for the GR-1 arms, waist and Fourier hands registration
Tabletop is the base class of the tabletop environments
Tabletop's default control_freq is 20 control signals per second
Tabletop's default horizon is 1000 timesteps
Tabletop steps the model at the model timestep rate until the control period elapses

determinism.notes: reset(seed) re-seeds the fake's Python random generator and the same seed plus the same actions repeats a trajectory; the upstream wrapper seeds numpy and resets the robosuite environment (gymnasium_basic.py:214-215), and the two were never compared

fidelity.engine: analytic:fake/GrootRoboCasaEnv for gr1_unified/PnPCupToDrawerClose_GR1ArmsAndWaistFourierHands_Env (upstream simulator: robosuite with MuJoCo)
gaps: the fake is kinematic: no rigid-body dynamics, contacts, actuators, sensors, noise or rendering; one action is applied per tick through a placeholder first-order filter, so this is an F0 model and the upstream MuJoCo physics (setup.py:21) is not represented

timestep_ms is 0 because the clone states no physics timestep; tabletop.py:278 declares control_freq=20 (a 50 ms control period) and tabletop.py:1069-1071 decimates the robosuite model timestep, whose value this clone does not state

the action and observation dimensions are the default GR-1 sizes named by the clone (seven per arm, three for the waist, six per Fourier hand); a different robosuite composite controller configuration at run time can change them and the fake does not model the controller
the image observation is a 2 x 2 x 3 stand-in for the upstream 256 x 256 x 3 uint8 frame (gymnasium_groot.py:19, :29) and the language annotation is always the empty string

the fake does not model task success: reward is always 0 and terminated/truncated are always false, while the upstream task subclasses define success through _check_success and reward (tabletop.py:1580-1603)

the fake's action keys drop the upstream 'action.' prefix: the wrapper names the parts action.left_hand, action.right_hand, action.left_arm, action.right_arm and action.waist (robocasa/models/robots/__init__.py:312-320), but the Gymnasium bridge addresses a Dict member as action.<key>, so a dotted key gives an unresolvable limit path; the fake exposes the same five parts as left_hand, right_hand, left_arm, right_arm and waist, while the sim backend would use the upstream names and was not run
the fake was never compared with the upstream environment and the sim backend (gymnasium.make of the registered id) was not run; the ids are only registered when robocasa.utils.gym_utils is imported
snapshot and restore are not offered: the wrapper exposes no get_state/set_state pair

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
